You will get an animation for at most ten draws. The progress bar shows the most draws left to get. Once you get an animation, the progress bar will be reset. We regularly update the prize pool. Some draw prize pool may be removed once you get the ultimate prize.  If there're no more animation prize available, the animation will be replaced with gems.

    The activity is not related to Apple Inc. The final interpretation right belongs to the game operator.
